# @three-ws/mcp-policy

> The three.ws MCP tool policy: every tool's group and tier, read-only by default with opt-in financial groups, named confirm flags, and preview ids that must precede every irreversible call.

@three-ws/mcp-policy is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/mcp-policy`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/mcp-policy/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/mcp-policy/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/mcp-policy/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/mcp-policy/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
